newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand finding new ways to boost slow exports.
newsitem.headline: Thailand finding new ways to boost slow exports.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Thursday he had directed the Commerce Ministry to find new measures to boost flagging exports in the first quarter.
"According to the central bank's primary data, the export growth is only two percent in the first quarter which is very low compared with the bank's target of seven percent," Amnuay told reporters.
"So I have ordered the Commerce Ministry to find any new ways to help improve exports," said Amnuay, who is also deputy prime minister in charge of all economic ministries.
The Bank of Thailand on Thursday said export growth in February contracted 5.5 percent compared with a 6.4 percent decline in January.
Amnuay earlier attributed the slow exports in the first quarter to falling prices of some major agricultural export products such as rubber and tapioca.
